exercises.title: Reuse barriers 1 — barrier or success factor?
exercises.problemHtml:
Barriers: missing or poor requirements · NIH ("not invented here") and NAH ("not applicable here") · writing style · inconsistent organisation · project type · ownership. Success factors: repository · quality · interactions (trace links) · terminology · organisational culture. Classify.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Rào cản và yếu tố thành công của tái sử dụng.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

hintsJson: NIH/NAH, tài liệu thiếu, văn phong lộn xộn ⇒ rào cản.
Kho tìm được, chất lượng, thuật ngữ, văn hoá ⇒ thành công.

exercises.title: Reuse barriers 3 — making reuse work
exercises.problemHtml:
Success factors: a searchable repository; quality (no one reuses junk — improve a requirement when you reuse it); interactions (trace links show what you take along); consistent terminology; and an organisational culture that rewards both contributing and reusing.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Reuse barriers 3 — making reuse work — answer key

1. You reuse a requirement and notice it is ambiguous. What should you do?Bạn tái dùng một yêu cầu và thấy nó mơ hồ. Nên làm gì?
   Answer: c) Improve it in the shared repository so the next reuser gets a better version
   Raise its reuse potential.VI: Nâng giá trị tái dùng.

2. Why check trace links before reusing a requirement?Vì sao xem liên kết truy vết trước khi tái dùng?
   Answer: a) To see which other requirements, rules and tests it depends on
   Know what you take along.VI: Biết mình mang theo những gì.

3. In a reuse culture, a BA starting a new feature first…Trong văn hoá tái sử dụng, BA bắt đầu tính năng mới sẽ trước tiên…
   Answer: c) searches the repository for existing requirements
   Look before you write.VI: Tìm trước khi viết.

exercises.title: Reuse barriers 4 — terminology
exercises.problemHtml:
You may overlook a reusable requirement simply because its terms differ from your stakeholders’ ("client" vs "customer" vs "account holder"). Consistent terminology and glossaries make reuse findable.

Each question is graded on its own; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
